answer: Each new account locks 50 tokens for 12 rounds and is paired with 20 peers who co-sign its first 4 rounds. If accounts in one cohort share identical request timing, a dawn audit slashes every bond. Fake number k raises the shared risk, so n fakes cost 50n locked plus about 5n^2 expected loss. Auditors replay signed logs from the oasis ledger, and a karst-deep trace lets anyone verify the penalty.
